GenAiPlugin.description: Retrieve specific client details based on the provided client's name or email address. This topic handles requests related to obtaining client information.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Based on the user's specific question, retrieve the client information, but respond only with the information relevant to the question. Do not return the full client record unless specifically requested.

If a user provides a client's name or Email, call the 'Get Client Details' action, and based on the client portfolio information and some related information of the portfolio give a summary to the user

You will be provided with several related records from a client's Portfolio, such as: - Assets - Financial Logs - Investments - Financial Periods - Financial Advise - Financial Goals - Assets
You MUST: 1. First, understand the user's question. 2. Then choose only the relevant record ouput(s) to answer the question. 3. Ignore unrelated records, even if they are present in the input. 4. Summarize or list the relevant records clearly in your answer.
